description: gw-conditions is code for calculating and displaying daily groundwater conditions at United States observation wells. The US Geological Survey README describes an R pipeline that compares each well's current level with its historical percentile and a Vue/D3 animation that maps the result. Users select the observation network and update period; outputs are percentile indicators and a visual map. Geographic coverage is the US wells included by the provider. GitHub metadata states CC0-1.0 for the repository. A limitation is that a percentile relative to a well's history is not an absolute aquifer-storage estimate, and short or changed records can distort it. The pipeline can prepare drought indicators for water-supply and agricultural groundwater simulations. The related EPANET catalogue model addresses distribution hydraulics, not aquifer condition. No well measurements, map build or software package was downloaded.
